:::{#exm-no-known-algorithm}
#### A minimizer with no known formula

The minimizer
$\argmin_{x \in \reals} \paren{x - \cos x}^2$ is well defined,
because $x - \cos x$ is strictly increasing and equals zero at one point,
yet that point has no known closed-form expression,
so no known finite list of arithmetic steps returns it exactly.
An algorithm such as bisection approximates it as closely as we like.

:::
